PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness — 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild general fitness safely post-cardiac event"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Improve cardiovascular capacity within HR limits"
  GOAL tertiary mobility:
    name "Maintain joint mobility and reduce stiffness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Foundation A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 3m
          child_pose 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Cardio and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 2x20..30 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x15..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m

      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Foundation B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x12 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 2x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 1m

    WEEK 2:
